citations.claim: NS yellow starts at step 151 (N shows yellow)
NS yellow still active at step 154, only 4th yellow second
first violation: NS already red at step 155 after only 4s yellow, required 6s

counterfactual.change: Set actuated true->false only; fixed-time control removes early yellow truncation and no violation occurs in 155 steps.

explanation: NS green ends at step 151 and NS yellow runs steps 151-154, but phase is already all-red before EW at step 155, i.e. yellow lasted only 4 s versus required yellow_seconds=6. No events are active, so emergency/ped/fail cannot explain it. The only active special logic is actuated control; with heavy EW queues waiting (~90 s) the controller appears to truncate the NS yellow to serve the recalled direction, violating yellow_duration. Turning actuated off removes the failure.
vision_note: In steps 152-154 the NS approaches show yellow while the EW approaches stay red with long blue queues waiting. At step 155 all approaches turn red, ending the yellow phase after only a few seconds without giving EW green.
